verdict.rationale: Working Copy keeps your data as standard Git repositories, which is an open format. You can get those repositories out through Files app access, the built-in WebDAV server, and pushing to any Git remote over https, ssh, git or http. The evidence does not describe a dedicated 'export everything' function, and says nothing about exporting app-level data such as identities, private keys or settings. missing for 10: documented bulk export of all app data including keys/identities/settings, explicit leave/off-boarding guidance, independent corroboration of full data portability

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: All repositories in Working Copy can be accessed in the Files app and 3rd party applications using the document picker or file browser components.
a good way to get files into and out of Working Copy is the built-in WebDAV server.
Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols.
